description: Authenticates a domain for sending with uSend (DKIM signature and the return-path hosts for both uSend transports) and routes incoming mail for the domain to uSend. DMARC is optional and is added by hand.
variableDescription: selector: DKIM selector shown in the uSend dashboard for the domain. dkimKey: base64 RSA public key (the p= value) of the domain's DKIM record. returnPathHost and sesReturnPathHost: uSend's return-path hosts for its two sending paths (today send.umta.et and send-ses.umta.et). mxHost: uSend's receiving host (today receive-use1.umta.et).
